title: fix(rest): open a csv export with the UTF-8 byte-order mark so Excel reads non-ASCII text
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_

Fixes #34163

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none (no authorable key or value; the CSV export body gains a leading UTF-8 byte-order mark. The dev confirms against the diff.)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`GET /api/v1/data/:object/export` 导出 CSV 时，文件开头写一个 UTF-8 字节序标记（BOM，EF BB BF），只写一次，放在表头行之前（`header=false` 时放在第一行数据之前）。JSON、XLSX、响应头都不变，没有新参数。
- 为什么改：Excel 打开没有 BOM 的 CSV 时按系统 ANSI 编码读，中文（以及任何非 ASCII）的表头和内容全部乱码；HTTP 头里的 `charset=utf-8` 不会跟着文件存到磁盘上。HotCRM 在 18.5.0 上实测复现。
- 风险与回滚：把导出正文当文本逐字节比较、又不用会去掉 BOM 的解码器的客户端，会在第一个单元格前看到 U+FEFF；`Response.text()`、浏览器 Blob 下载、平台自己的 CSV 导入都不受影响。完全没有内容的导出仍是 0 字节。回滚即撤销本 PR，不涉及存储数据。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts` 里 `UTF8_BOM` 常量和 CSV 分支的两处首次写入；`packages/rest/src/export-csv-utf8-bom-34163.test.ts`；`packages/rest/src/import-template-route.test.ts` 里改过的字节级期望值。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/export-csv-utf8-bom-34163.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件、8 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`: the `format=csv` leg (also the default format) prefixes `UTF8_BOM` (`'\uFEFF'`, spelled as the escape; the file holds no raw EF BB BF bytes) to the body's FIRST write, exactly once: the first chunk (header row, or the first data row under `header=false`) or, at zero rows, the authoritative header row. It is written after the first read, as before, so a refused query still answers the 400 envelope. An export that writes nothing (zero rows and no authoritative header) stays a zero-byte file, with no lone mark. `format=json` and `format=xlsx`, every response header (`Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8`, `Content-Disposition`, `X-Export-*`) and the closed query set are unchanged; no `bom` parameter and no option.
- Round trip: the csv import already strips one leading mark (`parseCsvToRows`, `packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts`), so an exported file re-imports unchanged; pinned.
- `.changeset/34163-csv-export-utf8-bom.md`: `@objectstack/rest` patch with both declaration lines.

## Tests

- New `packages/rest/src/export-csv-utf8-bom-34163.test.ts` (8 cases), through the real `HonoHttpServer` over a real `SqlDriver` (SQLite), reading the body as BYTES (`arrayBuffer()`): `Response.text()` drops a leading mark, so a text read could not tell the fix from the defect.
  - csv: exactly one EF BB BF, then the Chinese header row and cells; the headers unchanged. Also the default format and `header=false`.
  - csv with zero rows and `fields=`: one mark, then the header row alone. Zero rows with no authoritative header: zero bytes.
  - json opens with `[` and xlsx with `PK`: no mark.
  - round trip: the exported text, mark kept, parses through `parseCsvToRows` to the same header names and cells as the same text without the mark.
- 14 existing rest test files read the csv export body in-process as text and compared or split its first line. Each now strips exactly ONE leading U+FEFF at that read (an anchored regex, spelled as an escape); no assertion is otherwise changed. The three byte-identical csv pins in `import-template-route.test.ts` take the mark into their expected bytes (`bytes` + 3, `sha256` recomputed over the marked body; each old hash was first re-verified against its old text). The round-trip tests that feed the export straight to the import (`csv-text-cell-round-trip`, `export-boolean-locale`) still import the file WITH its mark. The list is in Acceptance notes. Two of them (`rest.test.ts`, `rest-14078-invalid-date-total-arm.test.ts`) also gain a module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql'`, which `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test whose source reaches that dynamic import.
- One consumer outside `packages/rest` reads the same export body: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.test.ts:802` (the #25078 export-then-admin-import round trip, caught red by Test Core (7/8) at 4de0e1e38f). Its header check now strips exactly one leading U+FEFF (anchored regex, spelled as the escape) and the admin import still receives the file with its mark, so this door's round trip covers the mark too. Test-only; plugin-auth publishes only dist, so no changeset. Fixed at 6e2297c2.

## Acceptance notes

- Decision inside the order: a csv export that writes NOTHING (zero rows and a schema-derived header with no readable projection, so the header stays unwritten to keep FLS-hidden names out) stays a zero-byte file rather than a lone mark. This keeps the pinned "headerless empty file" of that path true byte for byte; pinned in the new file.
- Pins flipped, every one only past or into the leading mark (file:line at the head):
  - `csv-text-cell-round-trip.test.ts:171` `csv.split(...)[0]` to `csv.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').split(...)[0]` (the import still receives the marked file).
  - `admin-import-users.test.ts:802` (plugin-auth): `csv.split(...)[0]` to `csv.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').split(...)[0]` (the admin import still receives the marked file); caught by Test Core (7/8) at 4de0e1e38f.
  - `export-boolean-locale.test.ts:153` (`csvRows`), `export-hidden-columns.test.ts:92` (`parseCsv`), `export-integration.test.ts:178` (`parseCsv`), `export-lookup-title-field.test.ts:167` (`parseCsv`): the csv-only parse helper strips one leading mark.
  - `export-date-year-pad.test.ts:219`, `import-business-timezone.test.ts:438`, `import-date-cell-iso-real-day.test.ts:252`, `import-datetime-year-below-100.test.ts:254`, `import-time-cell-fraction.test.ts:302`, `rest-14078-invalid-date-total-arm.test.ts:202`: the csv read before the header compare strips one leading mark.
  - `export-json-fields.test.ts:145`, `:176`, `:209`: the three csv reads (the shared `exportOf` also serves json, so the strip sits at the csv call sites).
  - `rest.test.ts:1080`, `:1232`, `:1249`, `:1392`, `:1402`: the in-process csv body reads.
  - `import-template-route.test.ts:692-694` csvDefault bytes 123 to 126, sha256 26d25190 to f5287f81, text gains `CSV_MARK`; `:718-720` csvFields 54 to 57, 62cd1868 to af30704a; `:725-727` csvNoHeader 78 to 81, 7f8f78c0 to 696b5d73. csvEmptyNoProjection (0 bytes) unchanged.
- Not changed here (ui/** is out of this PR's surface; same family, carried by follow-up card #34420): the Console's client-side CSV writers without a mark, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5886` (client-side fallback), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:1617`, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx:2309`, `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExportEngine.ts:54`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/IdentityImportPanels.tsx:87`. The Console's server export path saves the body with `res.blob()`, so this fix reaches its files. No other server-side CSV download writer exists in `packages/**`; no spec or docs text states the CSV body's first bytes.

## Verification

- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the test imports the route from source, so no dist leg): removing the mark from the first-chunk write gave Tests 4 failed, 4 passed (8); removing it from the zero-row header write gave Tests 1 failed, 7 passed (8), the zero-row case.
